title: noise.lyapunov
description: `noise.lyapunov` generates a two-dimensional random Lyapunov attractor by iterating the documented equations for x and y, providing the resulting coordinates through separate x and y outlets. Send it bangs, for example from `metro`, to output successive values; its coefficients and state can be set through arguments or the `a`, `b`, `x`, `y`, `set`, and `reset` messages.
